title: Riverbend Patient Payment Plan Change and Skip Allowances
content:
Each **Patient Payment Plan** tier allows a set number of patient-requested due-day or installment-amount changes over the plan's life, a lowest requested installment expressed as a percent of the computed installment (and never below the tier floor), and a number of installments the patient may skip, each skipped installment moving to the end of the term, over the plan's life.

| Tier | Changes over the plan's life | Lowest requested installment (percent of computed installment) | Skips over the plan's life |
|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 1 | 100 | 0 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 2 | 100 | 0 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 2 | 100 | 1 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 2 | 100 | 1 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 3 | 75 | 2 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 3 | 50 | 3 |

## Hypothetical illustration

On a plan whose computed installment is 200.00, a requested installment may go as low as 200.00 at 100 percent, 150.00 at 75 percent and 100.00 at 50 percent, in each case never below the tier's minimum monthly payment.
